description: This file defines validation primitives and error handling for protocol message validation in the Playwright project, including various validator functions for types like float, int, boolean, string, binary, and utility functions for optional and array validation.

classes.name: ValidationError
classes.description: Custom error class for validation errors.

methods.name: findValidator
methods.description: Retrieves a validator for a given type, method, and kind, throws if not found.

methods.name: maybeFindValidator
methods.description: Attempts to find a validator for a given type, method, and kind, returns undefined if not found.

methods.name: createMetadataValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator for metadata, optional.
